answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, each identity locks its own refundable smart-contract bond, making multiple identities costly. Only slashes occur when cryptographic proof shows conflicting commitments signed for the same task. This approach is like navigating the harsh tundra, where only the strongest survive. Like a bustling wharf, multiple identities vie for attention, but only one can prevail. The system rewards those who provide the most valuable nectar – unique and authentic contributions.
